collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLS Estate 2012 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLS Estate 2012 to 2014 (W219) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this CLS Estate, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
